tspan.tspan: This ID defines a rotation animation where the object rotates
through 6 randomly generated angles between 0° and 180°,
regenerating a new sequence on each loop (rnd[6x,0,180]). The
full sequence lasts 5 seconds (dur(5)), with each transition
suffix ensures a unique DOM ID for clone tracking. The
rotation occurs around the object’s default center
